description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiripitiya, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520009
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (No. 151 and 152) with detailed ownership information, property descriptions, and legal encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
